method_limits: generic single-channel TI family cores (OPAx196 Final 1.5, OPAx197 Final 1.3); no package parasitics, no coupling between the channels of a quad, no supply impedance
no temperature or tolerance corner: the factor of two stands in for them
0.20 pF/mm, the 1.5 route factor, 0.5 pF per via and 0.3 pF per pad are all ASSUMED (the last two new and unsourced)
Ruling 4 is pending its re-review in the placement brief
passives are ideal elements at their specification value; no vendor model exists for them and none is claimed
leakage, hum pickup and neighbour coupling are not covered by a capacitance budget
(Addendum B) the seed selects the zero-stray operating point, so no other DC state, such as a latched output or a start-up state, is examined
the feedback capacitor is an ideal 10 pF element (C0603C100J5GACTU has no retained vendor model)
its +/-5 % tolerance is not swept; the factor of two stands in for it
class G uses a two-step tolerance ladder (reltol=1e-5, then default)
arm R re-uses the S13 records and waveforms; the cache binding is by the recorded metrics, not by a data hash
